headline: The sentence in your head the first night you leave the baby
body:
~~I should be enjoying this more.~~
_You can miss them and still enjoy the soup._

~~They'll be upset that I'm gone.~~
_They're having a perfectly ordinary night with someone who loves them._

~~What kind of mom wants a night off?~~
_The kind who's been on every night for months._

~~Just one more look at my phone.~~
_Look. Then put it face down and order dessert._
